messages:
marta: FYI found ~74k events in sa-east missing session_window_id for 2026-06-14T11:02-11:28. dashboards for sessions and retention show a small dip.
vik: any deploys or config flips around that time?
ci-bot: deploy-tracker: session-windower v2 rolled at 2026-06-14T10:59 in sa-east. No crashes reported.
oscar: quick triage: session_window_id written as null when context payload had null windows. downstream aggregation assumed non-null and dropped rows.
marta: two choices: (A) run a heuristic reattach that infers session_window_id by device_id + 15m sliding window (fast, approx), or (B) full recompute of session aggregates for the window (accurate, costly).
vik: cost/accuracy numbers?
oscar: heuristic historically ~0.6% error; full recompute ~0.02%. Heuristic run for 74k events <1h on current fleet; recompute ~2.5h at normal capacity.
ria: product wants accurate numbers but also hates long blips. suggested hybrid: heuristic first + visible banner, then full recompute overnight at low priority if diffs exceed 0.5%.
console-bot: proposed banner copy: "Partial recompute in progress for sessions (ETA ~60m) — figures may change." feature flag console.replay_notice.session_windower_sa_east.
marta: safety: if we run heuristic, we must mark results with backfill_id and ensure idempotency and dedupe. Also throttle via router so realtime pipelines not starved.
vik: agree. router plan: temporary rule route->replay-priority when job.tag contains "heuristic-sa-east-0614" with priority-burst=12% for 90m. TTL enforced. fallback: if consumer 429s >3% or merge-lag >2m abort and schedule full recompute.
oscar: I can add a small audit query to estimate scope per tenant. ran it locally:
```sql
SELECT tenant_id, count(*) AS cnt FROM telemetry.events
WHERE session_window_id IS NULL AND region='sa-east'
AND created_ts BETWEEN '2026-06-14 11:02:00' AND '2026-06-14 11:28:00'
GROUP BY tenant_id;
-- sample: T42: 45220, T19: 19210, rest: ~10000
```
marta: suggestion: run heuristic only for tenants [T42, T19] (cover ~90% of the hole). full recompute conditional later.
ria: okay, UI will show banner for those tenants and link to backfill job in console job history. console.feature flag set to whitelist.
ci-bot: backfill-scheduler: queued job id=job-20260614-0077 tag=heuristic-sa-east-0614 owner=oscar scope=tenants:[T42,T19]
oscar: starting job job-20260614-0077 now. params: dedupe=true, heuristic_window=15m, concurrency=10, idempotency_tag=heuristic-sa-east-0614.
oscar: log: shard=0 processed=1024 reattached=998 ambiguous=1 errs=0
vik: routing updated; TTL 2h. will watch quota impact.
marta: monitoring note: watch 429s on parent-join and write QPS to aggregate store. abort criteria set.
oscar: mid-run update: 4/10 shards done, processed=37k reattached=36.4k ambiguous=48. no 429 spikes.
ria: banner enabled for T42/T19. message includes ETA ~45m and link to job id.
ci-bot: backfill-runner: job-20260614-0077 completed processed=74214 reattached=73862 ambiguous=352 errs=0
oscar: reconciliation: diffs for monitored metrics <0.45% for T42/T19. planning: schedule full recompute overnight at low priority to get within 0.05% if needed.
marta: good. disable priority-burst and remove router rule. leave banner until recompute done.
vik: I'll open a short PR to session-windower: schema guard to avoid null session_window_id and increment metric when null occurs. small fix + tests.
oscar: will add job link to incident note and include ambiguous count for product.
ria: product informed, banner will auto-disable after recompute completes.
ci-bot: incident-logger: created draft -> /incidents/2026-06-14-session-windower-heuristic-draft.md
marta: summary/action items: oscar -> schedule full recompute low-priority overnight, vik -> router TTL PR and guard PR, ria -> keep banner and update product, marta -> finalize incident note. thanks team.
